title: Chapter 610
paragraphs: Chapter 610
156th Episode. Purification of Chaos (14)
Again, Jin stood in front of the gate of Chaos.
As always, all the brothers of the Ming Clan alternately looked at Jin and the gate of Chaos.
"Today, his fate will be determined."
"Whatever choice Brother Jin makes, we will sincerely follow."

Jin looked at Vahn, who was standing with a blank expression on her face. In her calm eyes, a lonely feeling she had been harboring while looking at the gate of chaos for the past two days was present.
"I will be back."
Upon entering the gate, the empty darkness of Chaos greeted Jin.
Originally, as soon as he entered, he could see the huge body of Chaos. Every time, he had started the battle by facing a powerful front foot swing, or a super powerful tail swing.
Now, whether because it had lost its power, or for some other reason, Chaos was not visible.
So Jin moved forward aimlessly.
He walked slowly for about an hour.
And for the first time since Jin entered the territory of Chaos, he could realize that there was an 'end' in this dark space.
An unusually black curtain began to appear. At first, he thought it was a point leading to the unconsciousness of Chaos, as it was in the abyss of Gleeak, but it was just the end.
As if blocked by a wall, he couldn't move forward. Even when cut with a spiritual sword, no cracks opened, and it did not break.
As he walked along the wall a little more, in the distance, he could see Chaos crouching.
Chaos stood up as Jin came into view, looking even smaller than the last time he saw it.
It maintained the form of a dragon, but overall it was so round that it almost looked like a baby rabbit. It was a size that wouldn't fill the palm of the hand.
Moreover, Chaos no longer felt the destructive power it used to have. At the time when it was hit by Jin's spiritual sword ultimate move, Chaos had lost almost all its power.
[Hmm, you brat. Already intoxicated by the sense of victory, your smug face is really disgusting.]
Jin had a blank face.
"The divine brothers outside said so. It's not that you couldn't kill me, but you didn't kill me because you might be lonelier. Is that true?"
[What do you care, now that you're going to kill me.]
Jin unsheathed his sword and laid it down beside him. Then he raised his hand to show that he had no intention of attacking, and sat down ten steps away from Chaos.
"You never know, my mind may change depending on your answer."
[Huh! Are you at ease because you can handle me even without a weapon now?]
"You're quite twisting the perspective."

[Doesn't it look that way? My life is ruined because of you. Originally, I should have hatched perfectly by becoming one with you, but that was distorted thanks to your brothers who took me out. Then we could have lived our own lives, but you rushed to kill me.]
"That's natural since you took away my power, isn't it?"
[Those monster-like brothers of yours only took your side. They ignored all of my appeals.]
"The issue could have been resolved if you returned my power."

[If I returned that, I would have no use and would have been killed by you and those monsters! Would I have even thought of having a conversation like now? Besides, you keep saying I stole it, but that's my power?]
A moment of silence flowed.
"You said your life was ruined a while ago, is that because you lost all your power? Or is it because once you're in here, you can't get out on your own?"
[...Wait, how do you know I can't get out by myself?]
"The divine brothers told me. Every time I opened a crack, your inner self was communicated."
Chaos's pupils widened. Chaos had no idea about that.
[Ha! Really? So you knew everything. Yet you kept watching me trying to kill you? Impressive.]
Chaos clenched its teeth, seeming aggrieved.
"She is my sibling. It's only natural to categorize you as an enemy."
Jin shrugged his shoulders.
He took a moment to retrace the dark space he had walked through. It was literally a land of nothing but pitch-darkness, and even that would end if you walked for about an hour.
When he thought that this was all that was allowed to Chaos, he felt even more bitter.
'The reason why the divine brothers looked at the gate with such lonely eyes must have been because they felt his loneliness keenly.'
Jin too could read Chaos's inner self when it was outside. Even then, when he was full of anger towards Chaos, he felt pity for it.
Somehow, Shuri came to his mind. His enemy's grave, which had been abandoned for nearly a thousand years, spent alone in a desolate thorn bush in one corner of the Black Sea.
Let's save it.
Jin made that decision.
"You can't read my thoughts now, can you?"
[You're thinking about how to finish me off.]
"It's the opposite. But there are a few concerns."
[What?]
"First, I heard you are the first Chaos that started from the witch Heluram. And the first Chaos is said to have especially uncontrollable characteristics."
[What's this witch Heluram.]
"What did you say?"
[I don't know anything like that. I just woke up inside you.]
Chaos had no perception of itself as the 'first chaos that started from the witch.' That's why it always perceived Jin's power as 'its own.'
Chaos thought it was not born from a witch, but from Jin.
"Then why did you react so sensitively to the spirit energy?"
[It's an instinctual fear. To the point where I can't understand how I could exist from someone like you who holds such a thing.]
For example, Chaos was a kind of 'seed'. The power of Heluram simply settled in Jin's inner self as if a seed had sprouted.
To Chaos, it was not important who sowed the seed, and it was not curious either.
Originally, the intention to devour Jin and become one was nothing more than an instinctual growth process from Chaos's perspective.
As Chaos explained this, Jin couldn't help but let out a hollow laugh.
"Hard to believe stories."
[You'll find out right away whether this is a lie or not when you go out. Your monster brothers should be able to read my inner self.]
"You're not trying to get out?"

[You really don't trust me to the end. From the start, I was scared of your monster brothers, and because you kept resonating with the monster brothers and getting stronger, I ran away here. Now I've lost my power, what can I do even if I go outside? I have no cards left, thanks to you!]
It didn't seem like a lie.
'After all, even when he had power, he was very afraid of the brothers.'
Jin nodded.
"Okay, I'll take you out. How do I do it?"
[Just open the rift... Really?]

"Since I've regained all my power, I don't really have a reason to kill you. Personal grudges have also been somewhat resolved. There is one last remaining issue, but I can tolerate that much for the divine brothers."
[...For the divine brothers?]
Whooosh-!
Jin unfolded his spiritual sword and opened the rift.
"Let's go."
Chaos stood in front of the rift following Jin and hesitated for a moment.
[When I go out, wouldn't your monster brothers hate me?]
"I don't know. If you want to stay here, do that."
[No, no. I'm going, I'm going.]
As soon as Jin and Chaos came out to the training ground, the demon king clans opened their eyes in wonder.
"Is that the first chaos?"
"It's gotten so small, hasn't it?"
"He said he wanted to give him a chance, and in the end, it seems like brother Jin decided to save that guy."
"Since it's come to this, let's welcome him warmly. He's sort of cute too."

"Oh, Jin brother. Well done! Actually, I was worried about what would happen if the brother killed that guy. Nice to meet you, I am King Boras of Otu! As I'll need your help with some research in the future, it'd be best for us to get along quickly, right?"
At the unexpected hospitality, Chaos showed a flustered look and hid behind Jin. Jin also noticed Vahn's narrowed brow.
She could read the inner feelings of Chaos as soon as they came out to Lafrarosa.
On the other hand, Jin couldn't hear Chaos's feelings.
"Come closer."
Vahn reached out her hand to Chaos.
Chaos cautiously climbed onto her hand after looking for her approval.
'He kept saying that he was scared and hated being a monster, but to Vahn brother, he's like a gentle lamb.'
One last remaining issue.
Just before coming out, Jin was referring to the black spots remaining on his body.
He had a hunch they would disappear if Chaos was killed, but Jin kept Chaos alive for Vahn.
Because he saw her looking so sad.
Vahn felt Chaos's loneliness as if it were her own, and along with compassion, she felt a kind of empathy. The empathy of being trapped in a dead world from which she could never escape on her own.
That's why she looked at Chaos's door with such lonely eyes.
Chaos seemed to be saying something continuously in its inner voice on Vahn's hand. Vahn often nodded her head and answered.
"......So, that's how you can remove Jin brother's spots? I see. Jin brother."
"Speak, divine brother."
"I will take care of this child now."
Jin didn't question Vahn.
Because her decision meant that she was certain Chaos could never threaten him and his brothers.
Black energy, like spirit energy, flowed out from Chaos's body.
The energy circled around Vahn and was absorbed into her heart.
As Chaos's energy seeped into Vahn's heart, the spots that spread like tumors all over Jin's body faded and disappeared.
It looked like a kind of contract, but from Chaos's perspective, it was a 'move'.
'But, how could you be so cruel? Even though you read my inner feelings.'
'That's because you tried to harm Jin brother.'
'So you decided to take me in because I might be helpful to that damn guy.'
Vahn replied by stroking Chaos's head to his words.
'It's not just because of that.'
And Chaos was reading Vahn's inner feelings. The sincerity that she had pitied him so much since the first time her inner feelings were transmitted through the rift.
